status.en: 375 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 23% fewer than the week before, most of them in Delhi, Mumbai and Hyderabad.
status.nb: 375 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 23 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Delhi, Mumbai og Hyderabad.

summary.en: Security forces in Manipur continue large-scale operations, seizing arms, grenades, ammunition, narcotics and a Kuki-Zo insurgent camp while reviewing border fencing and joint grids. Deputy chief ministers are at odds after one linked the other’s husband’s outfit to the killing of six Nagas, and a Naga killings row has prompted calls for one deputy CM to step down. In Jammu and Kashmir the lieutenant governor chaired a unified headquarters meeting on district security and ordered strengthened cyber security across all departments. A truck collision killed its driver in Ramban and two people were buried alive by a sand mound in Baramulla. The UCDP recorded 437 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Sikkerhetsstyrker i Manipur fortsetter store operasjoner, beslaglegger våpen, granater, ammunisjon, narkotika og en Kuki-Zo-opprørsleir mens de gjennomgår grensegjerdet og felles nett. Visepremierministerne er i konflikt etter at den ene knyttet den andres manns organisasjon til drapet på seks nagaer, og en nagadrap-sak har ført til krav om at en visepremierminister skal gå av. I Jammu og Kashmir ledet lederen av unionsterritoriet et samlet hovedkvartermøte om distriktsikkerhet og beordret styrket cybersikkerhet i alle departementer. En lastebilkollisjon drepte sjåføren i Ramban, og to personer ble begravd levende av en sandhaug i Baramulla. UCDP registrerte 437 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Kashmir conflict
background.extract: The Kashmir conflict is a territorial conflict over the Kashmir region, primarily between India and Pakistan, and also between China and India in the northeastern portion of the region. The conflict started after the partition of India in 1947 as both India and Pakistan claimed the entirety of the former princely state of Jammu and Kashmir. It is a dispute over the region that escalated into three wars between India and Pakistan and several other armed skirmishes. India controls approximately 55% of the land area of the region that includes Jammu, the Kashmir Valley, most of Ladakh, the Siachen Glacier, and 70% of its population; Pakistan controls approximately 30% of the land area that includes Azad Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan; and China controls the remaining 15% of the land area that includes the Aksai Chin region, the mostly uninhabited Trans-Karakoram Tract, and part of the Demchok sector.
